description: Scoped to one group on purpose: the bug reporter builds Sentry replay envelopes itself (ADR 8 in the bug reporter spec), so the Sentry SDK and rrweb are pinned to exact versions and move together, behind the release-tier tests. The `bug-reporter-release` label starts .github/workflows/bug-reporter-release.yml on the PR.
Every other dependency is left alone here; widen `enabled` below if Renovate should manage more.

packageRules.description: ADR 8: @sentry/* and @sentry-internal/* (rrweb and its player) in one PR, pinned exactly.
